stories.title: Festival to celebrate 300th anniversary of overlooked Welsh naturalist who inspired Charles Darwin
stories.summary: A festival is being held to celebrate 300 years since the birth of overlooked Welsh naturalist Thomas Pennant, who is said to have inspired Charles Darwin. stories.title: Met Office to inspect Hawarden weather station after provisional Wales record
stories.summary: A weather station at Hawarden Airport recorded 32.2C on Monday 25 May, a provisional new all-time May temperature record for Wales. stories.title: Ewloe shut for four days as Flintshire roadworks list grows
stories.summary: A busy week ahead for Flintshire drivers, with closures on three main routes and temporary lights on several others. stories.title: What is the Senedd Commission and what does it do?
stories.summary: The Senedd Commission is often mentioned when discussing Welsh politics – but what actually is it and what does it do? The Government of Wales Act 2006 gave the then National Assembly for Wales considerable new legislative powers. stories.summary: A new stage version of Virginia Woolf’s Mrs Dalloway will get its world premiere at Storyhouse in Chester from Friday 29 May.
